title: Fire truck with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- background is Doot's dark screen, so no background rect -->
  
  <!-- wheels - dark purple-blue with lighter hubcaps -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='76' r='12' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='76' r='6' fill='#8a7ab5'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#c4b8e0'/>
  
  <circle cx='73' cy='76' r='12' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='76' r='6' fill='#8a7ab5'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#c4b8e0'/>
  
  <!-- main body - bright red -->
  <rect x='10' y='42' width='80' height='34' rx='4' fill='#e83030'/>
  
  <!-- lighter red top edge for contrast -->
  <rect x='10' y='42' width='80' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ff5c5c'/>
  
  <!-- cab - slightly different red, lighter -->
  <rect x='60' y='30' width='30' height='46' rx='4' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <rect x='60' y='30' width='30' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff7777'/>
  
  <!-- windshield - bright light blue, looks like glass -->
  <rect x='64' y='36' width='22' height='16' rx='3' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <rect x='64' y='36' width='22' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b0e0f0'/>
  
  <!-- side window on cab -->
  <rect x='62' y='56' width='12' height='10' rx='2' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  
  <!-- ladder on top - light grey/silver -->
  <rect x='18' y='30' width='2.5' height='14' rx='1' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  <rect x='28' y='30' width='2.5' height='14' rx='1' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='2.5' height='14' rx='1' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  <!-- ladder rungs -->
  <rect x='18' y='31' width='22.5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='18' y='36' width='22.5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='18' y='41' width='22.5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  
  <!-- hose coil on side - yellow -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='7' fill='#f5c842'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#e83030'/>
  
  <!-- bumper - light grey -->
  <rect x='8' y='72' width='84' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c8c8c8'/>
  
  <!-- headlight - bright yellow -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ffe44d'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='58' r='2' fill='#fff8c0'/>
  
  <!-- SMILEY FACE on the front of the truck body -->
  <!-- eyes - bright white -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- pupils - dark but lit, bright centred -->
  <circle cx='30.5' cy='52.5' r='2' fill='#2a1a50'/>
  <circle cx='46.5' cy='52.5' r='2' fill='#2a1a50'/>
  
  <!-- big smile - white curve -->
  <path d='M24 60 Q38 72 52 60' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- little blush cheeks - light pink -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#ffaaaa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#ffaaaa' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- front grille hint - darker red lines -->
  <rect x='62' y='68' width='24' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#cc2222'/>
  <rect x='62' y='72' width='24' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#cc2222'/>
</svg>
